# This is Suricata version 8.0.8 RELEASE, run by make-action-verdicts.py; do not edit by hand.
# 'rule SID RULE', or 'refused SID RULE' when Suricata does not load it,
# then 'packet NS HEX SIDS': the packet's time in nanoseconds, its IP
# bytes and the sids that alerted on it, a sid once per alert, '-' for none,
# then 'end N SIDS': what alerted when flow N was flushed at the end of
# the capture, its last address byte being N, then 'proto N NAME': the
# application protocol Suricata logged for flow N.
